items.summary: leafpress is a modern, minimalistic, opinionated static-site generator for digital gardeners like me. It allows wrapping over any existing folder of MD files and quickly generate website from it. Common markdown and Obsidian-specific syntax/features are supported. It offers decent amount of UI configurability with a JSON-based config file that allows tweaking colours, fonts, navigation, etc. It’s also much faster than most of the SSGs out there. Show HN: I analyzed all 191 prompts I used to "vibe-code" an app
items.summary: One-shot performance of LLMs is a good measure of many of its capacities, but it is only sufficient for tasks that can be objectively and automatically verified. I believe that in most real-world cases this is not the case: people have vague, unquantifiable, taste-based, complex goals, and it's the way one works closely with AI over many prompts that makes the difference between slop and actual work. Movie forums are great, but it's also very dense, and finding something could turn into a weekend project. items.summary: Hi HN, I'm Tosh, founder of ymove.app. For five years we have built white label apps for fitness coaches. Every app needed exercise demos, and the options were animated GIFs (ExerciseDB style), stock footage that never matches, or filming it yourself. I ended up filming it myself: a white studio, lots of fitness equipment, trainers and physiotherapists, the same framing and light for every clip.
